title: Director, Asset Protection & Safety - International
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>WHY JOIN ALO?</strong></span></p> <p>Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.</p></div><p><strong>OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>The Director of Asset Protection & Safety International, based out of London, leads ALO’s enterprise protection strategy across international retail markets, ensuring operational integrity, the safety of our people and guests, and the protection of company assets. This leader combines operational discipline, innovation, and mindful leadership to protect both performance and brand experience across diverse regulatory, cultural, and risk environments.</p> <p>The Director is responsible for developing, standardizing, and scaling a comprehensive international retail protection program across the UK, Europe, and APAC. This role integrates operational risk management, safety governance, investigations, and resilience into a cohesive strategy that positions ALO’s Asset Protection & Safety organization as a global center of excellence for protection and prevention. This role will report into the Sr. Director Asset Protection & Safety</p> <p>This leader is both visionary and practical, using data, technology, and human insight to anticipate emerging risks and create scalable solutions that sustain trust, profitability, and operational excellence across international markets. The role partners across Operations, People & Culture, Legal, Finance, IT, Facilities, and Supply Chain to ensure ALO’s protection and safety programs evolve ahead of industry trends while remaining compliant with local laws and cultural expectations.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES </strong><em> </em></p> <p><em>Leadership & Culture</em></p> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing international field organization, including Regional Asset Protection Managers and supporting Asset Protection and Safety resources across multiple countries.</li> <li>Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and care that supports safety, team engagement, and business performance.</li> <li>Model and embody ALO’s Guiding Principles of mindful movement, community, intention, and purpose.</li> <li>Partner with international retail and field leaders to reinforce consistent execution of Asset Protection and Safety standards.</li> <li>Maintain visible engagement in the field to assess readiness and reinforce duty of care expectations.</li> </ul> <p><em>Strategic Direction & Execution</em></p> <ul> <li>Lead ALO’s international Asset Protection & Safety strategy across External Risk, Internal Integrity, Operational Excellence, and People Protection.</li> <li>Establish scalable governance models aligning global standards with local regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Ensure strategies are data-informed and aligned to long-term growth.</li> </ul> <p><em>External Risk</em></p> <ul> <li>Develop proactive strategies to deter and respond to external theft and organized retail crime.</li> <li>Build relationships with law enforcement, security partners, and retail coalitions.</li> <li>Oversee theft and fraud case management and recovery efforts.</li> <li>Represent ALO in international protection networks.</li> <li>Oversee security vendor programs and guard force management.</li> </ul> <p><em>Internal Integrity</em></p> <ul> <li>Lead internal investigations with discretion and cultural sensitivity.</li> <li>Partner with People & Culture and Legal on compliant case handling.</li> <li>Oversee restitution, recovery, and authority coordination.</li> <li>Ensure cash-handling integrity and audit consistency.</li> <li>Reinforce ethical behavior and accountability programs.</li> </ul> <p><em>Operational Excellence</em></p> <ul> <li>Partner cross-functionally to mitigate controllable loss.</li> <li>Standardize international retail audit programs.</li> <li>Use analytics to forecast risk and guide prevention.</li> <li>Support new store openings and remodels.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><em>People Protection, Safety & Business Continuity</em></p> <ul> <li>Champion a culture of safety, preparedness, and wellbeing.</li> <li>Provide executive oversight of workplace violence prevention.</li> <li>Oversee crisis management and business continuity frameworks.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.</li> <li>Lead post-incident reviews and resilience planning.</li> </ul> <p><em>Technology, Analytics & Innovation</em></p> <ul> <li>Modernize protection and safety platforms through technology.</li> <li>Optimize systems for reporting and analytics.</li> <li>Evaluate innovative prevention tools.</li> <li>Oversee physical security and life-safety systems.</li> <li>Present insights and outcomes to executive leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Business, Risk Management, or related field.</li> <li>Fifteen or more years of progressive leadership experience with international scope.</li> <li>Proven success building scalable protection and safety programs.</li> <li>Experience overseeing investigations, audits, crisis response, and business continuity.</li> <li>Strong understanding of international retail risk and safety governance.</li> <li>Excellent leadership and communication skills.</li> <li>High integrity and sound judgment.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally up to 40 to 50 percent.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="c-scrollbar__hider" title: Strategic Account Director - Financial Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Sayari: </strong></h2> <div> <p>Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.</p> </div></div><h2>The Opportunity</h2> <p>We are taking the Commercial World Model into its next phase: agentic AI that reasons over it directly, running investigations and surfacing risk the way a senior analyst would, then returning sourced assessments for human review.</p> <p>You would build and scale a new product line with the backing of an established, proven global organization. It offers the freedom of an entrepreneur inside a business, with talented resources behind you, including forward-deployed engineers and analysts dedicated to your accounts. It is a front-row seat to the changes shaping global markets right now.</p> <p>We are hiring a Strategic Account Director to bring deep subject matter expertise to our financial services vertical. You will join an already strong sales team and take it further into the relationships, domain depth, and agentic use cases this vertical needs next. You bring the network and the credibility that only years inside this sector can build.</p> <p>You won’t be the first rep at Sayari, but you will be one of the first people anywhere selling agentic investigation and risk agents into this vertical, on a foundation of data other vendors in our space don’t have. That’s the pitch you’ll be making, and it’s a true one.</p> <p>This is a senior, relationship-led seat focused on enterprise outcomes: multiyear agreements of $2M+, and agentic AI adoption that spreads into every adjacent buying center inside your accounts. Financial services runs on relationships that take years to earn. We want people who already have them and can use them to go deeper in a vertical we are already investing in, not start one from nothing.</p> <p>The seat owns a high-value EMEA enterprise book with a dual mandate: expand what’s already there, and open new tier-1 logos through your own network. It is not a renewal seat, and it is not a customer-success seat with a senior title.</p> <h2>What You Will Drive</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own the full cycle.</strong> Win new business from the first conversation with a target account through a signed multiyear agreement. Self-generate 60%+ of your pipeline through your network, targeted outreach, and practitioner communities, not inbound leads.</li> <li><strong>Deepen the playbook.</strong> Bring domain expertise that sharpens how we sell agentic AI into this vertical. Refine our methodology, positioning, and use-case narrative based on what you know works with this buyer, and share it with the wider team.</li> <li><strong>Expand within accounts.</strong> Move accounts from a single agentic use case to enterprise-wide deployment across the Commercial World Model and our AI agents.</li> <li><strong>Map the executive landscape.</strong> Build trusted relationships across every function that touches risk: compliance and legal leadership, risk operations, investigations teams, procurement, and IT. Think Chief Risk Officers, Chief Compliance Officers, and General Counsel.</li> <li><strong>Prove the agent, then scale it.</strong> Partner with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and your forward-deployed team to get agentic workflows into production with top-tier customers first. Use early wins as references to open net-new budget across the account.</li> <li><strong>Inform the roadmap.</strong> You are on the front line of how this vertical reacts to agentic AI. Take that market intelligence back to Product and Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Run a rigorous pipeline.</strong> Maintain a predictable pipeline using a structured sales methodology, and give leadership a forecast they can plan against.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <ul> <li><strong>A domain expert.</strong> 15+ years immersed specifically within the financial services blue-chip segment with C-Suite level context with a focus on banking compliance, risk and technology with a real, live and verifiable network already established inside that sector. Not adjacent experience. You know the regulatory environment, the day-to-day challenges practitioners face, and the trends shaping the sector.</li> <li><strong>A proven closer.</strong> A history of closing multimillion-dollar, multiyear agreements and driving net-new revenue from both existing complex accounts and new logos, which you can walk through in specific, named detail.</li> <li><strong>A strong communicator.</strong> Executive presence that lets you explain data provenance and AI reasoning to non-technical senior stakeholders, and be treated as a peer rather than a vendor.</li> <li><strong>A strategist.</strong> You navigate complex procurement, legal review, and multithreaded account politics, and can move from a single buyer into two or more adjacent buying centers. You are fluent in a structured methodology such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Miller Heimann.</li> <li><strong>A practitioner’s peer.</strong> You have spent your career inside this vertical, not selling into it from the outside. You can hold a substantive conversation with a senior practitioner on the regulatory, operational, or risk pressures they face.</li> <li><strong>A builder and pioneer.</strong> You are energized by growing something rather than maintaining it, with experience building a territory, book, vertical, or motion from scratch.</li> <li><strong>Curious about agentic AI.</strong> You don’t need to be technical, but you need to be the person in the room who can explain what agentic AI can and can’t yet do.</li> <li><strong>Ready to travel.</strong> Up to 25%, to be in the room with the accounts and stakeholders that matter most.</li> </ul> <h2>The Team Behind Every Deal</h2> <ul> <li>Forward-deployed engineers and analysts dedicated to your accounts, embedded with the customer’s risk, compliance, and AI infrastructure teams to prove real use cases.</li> <li>Solutions Engineering, to run technical proof and translate data provenance for non-technical stakeholders alongside you.</li> <li>Customer Success, to land the first use case and turn it into a reference you can use to expand the account.</li> <li>Marketing and BDR support on the remaining share of your pipeline. This is a network-and-credibility hire, not a “we have no leads” hire.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY TOP PERFORMERS CHOOSE SAYARI</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Uncapped Revenue Upside: </strong>An aggressive, uncapped commission structure with market leading accelerators for expansion revenue, and no bonus caps.</li> <li><strong>Genuinely Novel Product: </strong>Sell agentic AI that shows its work and traces every finding to a primary source. Not a black box, and not a chatbot wrapper. You will be one of the first people selling autonomous investigation and risk agents into this vertical anywhere in the market.</li> <li><strong>Elite Benefits: </strong> UK: fully paid private medical, dental, vision, salary sacrifice benefits.</li> <li><strong>Retirement: </strong>UK: 8% pension</li> <li><strong>True Rest: </strong>UK: 25 days plus bank holidays, plus a company-wide winter shutdown and other market leading leave policies.</li> </ul> <div> </div> <div><em>Sayari is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and a fair recruitment process. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic under applicable UK law.</em></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Account Executive, UKI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/our-network"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">private, global, multi-cloud IP network</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">, to bringing </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">hyperlocal edge</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p> </p> <div id="message-list_1789138788.172169"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>The Role</strong><br><br>We're building local Enterprise Sales Pods across global markets — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in the UK and Ireland. This is not a remote overlay on an existing territory. You will own a named-account list of 30–40 enterprise accounts across the UK and Ireland, and your job is to turn those accounts into production Telnyx customers.<br><br>You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated FDE — not a demo resource, but a technical partner who designs architectures, builds POCs, and gets the first workload live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.<br><br>This is a founding role. You'll help define how Telnyx sells into enterprise accounts in the UK and Ireland, set the playbook, and build the references that the next wave of hires will follow.<br><br><em>The Pod Model</em><br><br><em>Enterprise AE</em> — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.<br><br><em>Forward Deployed Engineer</em> — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.<br><br>We sell the <em>workload</em>, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong><br><br>• Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts across the UK and Ireland, narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential<br>• Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners<br>• Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close<br>• Sell production outcomes, not individual products — lead with "let's deploy an AI agent that operates your SOC or NOC workflow," not "which Telnyx products do you want?"<br>• Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development<br>• Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end<br>• Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer<br>• Build local references and case studies across London and Dublin<br>• Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises<br><br><strong>What We're Looking For</strong><br><br>• 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into the UK and/or Irish market — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure<br>• Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals)<br>• Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review<br>• Hunter mentality — you build your own pipeline and thrive on outbound, in-person selling<br>• Strong consultative selling skills: can build a clear, compelling ROI story for both technical and business buyers<br>• Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, etc.)<br>• Comfortable with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, etc.)<br>• Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You listen before you pitch.<br>• Willingness to be in the field — visiting customers in person is a core part of this role<br>• Based in London, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the UK and Ireland<br><br><em>Bonus Points For</em><br><br>• Fortune 500 or large enterprise new business sales experience in the UK or Ireland</div> <div>• Complex sales cycles including RFPs, POCs, and competitive bake-offs<br>• C-Level selling experience — you can navigate procurement, security, and legal complexity, including UK enterprises (BT Group, Vodafone UK, Lloyds Banking Group, HSBC, Barclays, Tesco, Unilever, BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce) and Irish enterprises (Eir, Ryanair, Kerry Group, Smurfit Kappa, AIB, CRH)<br>• Understanding of SIP trunking, phone number provisioning, carrier networks, or AI/ML platforms<br>• Established relationships in the London enterprise ecosystem — fintech, telecom, media, healthcare, insurance, or SaaS<br>• Experience with UK public sector and government procurement frameworks (G-Cloud, Crown Commercial Service)<br>• Irish language skills or existing relationships in the Dublin enterprise ecosystem</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-RH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior FSQA Manager - PHF (all genders)
description: <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">About The Team:</span></strong></p> <p>Are you passionate about building food safety standards and driving product quality? We are looking for someone with technical experience to drive food safety and quality compliance.</p> <p>Our Food Safety & Quality Assurance team is recruiting and we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Food Safety professional to join our international team. You will work within a team based across Europe to drive food safety and quality compliance with our Produce, Herbs & Fruit (PHF) suppliers, and work collaboratively with our procurement, sourcing, supply chain and distribution centre teams. The role will share best practice, create standardized ways of working, drive improvement in food safety & quality and lead on various strategic projects to ensure we delight our customers.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></span></p> <p>You will...</p> <ul> <li>Perform on-site supplier visits and audits to manage their approval and drive strategic improvements in quality to decrease complaints and increase customer satisfaction</li> <li>Use your expertise and knowledge from industry and the supply base to develop best practice ways of working with your suppliers and internally</li> <li>Strategically manage supplier product quality and performance. Delivering focussed error (complaint) reduction initiatives and identifying projects that will improve our quality and safety standards</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance</li> <li>Investigate and manage quality issues with suppliers to ensure customer availability and quality is not compromised with thorough root cause analysis and corrective action</li> <li>Own your category area to achieve key performance indicators relating to out of specification deliveries, customer complaints, and compliance metrics</li> <li>Manage and coordinate the onboarding of new suppliers and products ensuring compliance to food safety, legal and quality standards</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in quality and food safety management, ideally within the produce industry</li> <li>Experience in auditing food manufacturers; additional food safety qualifications (e.g. HACCP, internal auditing) are highly desirable</li> <li>Willingness to travel, including some international trips; 50% of time spent at suppliers, distribution centres and the base office</li> <li>Excellent English communication and negotiation skills; pragmatic in solving time-sensitive issues - German skills are a big plus</li> <li>Confident decision-maker who remains calm under pressure and in challenging situations</li> <li>Thrives in a fast-paced environment with the ability to multitask across competing priorities</li> <li>Comfortable working with cross-functional and international teams across HelloFresh markets (UK, DACH, France, Nordics, BNL)</li> <li>intermediate to advanced skills in Google Suite / MS Office</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you will get in return:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>Gym membership</li> <li>Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)</li> <li>Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme</li> <li>Nursery support scheme</li> <li>Cycle to work scheme</li> <li>Group Life Assurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong>: The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London</p> <p><strong>To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.</strong></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Hybrid Working Policy</strong><br>We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p><strong>Next steps</strong>: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.</p> <p>You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company. </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Every parcel ends at a door. Where that door is, where a courier can park, and which way they walk in decide whether a handover takes seconds or minutes, and whether anyone ends up at the wrong place at all. Most of that never shows up on a map. Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Turning those traces into a trusted picture of the real last mile is the foundation the rest of our Science builds on. Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. Location intelligence is where it starts. Location Intelligence Highlights Telematics from the couriers who deliver for us: GPS traces, stops, parking spots and building entrances, all from live deliveries. Mapping and road networks: where addresses and front doors really are, and how roads and traffic really behave. A foundation layer: your work feeds routing, optimisation and courier intelligence, and gives our decision teams the evidence to tell a wrong address from a failed handover. One of the first hires into Relay's new Location Intelligence team, with room to set the direction. The Opportunity As a Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence at Relay, you'll: Lead location intelligence at Relay, turning telematics and map data into a trusted picture of where deliveries really happen. Build the methods that find the front door: map matching, stop and dwell detection, and parking and entrance inference from messy GPS traces. Model road networks, traffic and travel times, so routes and plans reflect how the city really moves. Take models from prototype to production, and own their quality once they are live. Partner with Operational Research, Courier Intelligence and Engineering so correct addresses and doors flow into routing and decisions. Raise the standard for location science at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community. We're looking for candidates who… Have hands-on experience with telematics or GPS data: individual traces, map matching, and stop or dwell detection. Have worked on a mapping or location product, whether an online maps platform or an internal mapping product for a delivery or mobility app. Come from a STEM background, with strong statistics and solid data and coding fundamentals. Have shipped location models into production, and owned them after launch. Have set technical direction that others worked to, and brought people with them. Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. title: Growth Associate
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. About Dex Dex is backed by Notion Capital, a16z and Concept Ventures, with angels from OpenAI, Wise, ElevenLabs, Meta’s board, and many more. We’re an ambitious, direct and kind group of people, we value authenticity, ambition and people who make things happen. We’re a team of 28 (and growing) based in London. We work together 3 times a week because we value in person time, but we’re person centric and flexible. We hire adults who can manage their own schedules. The Role 40,000+ engineers have joined Dex, and we plan to 10x that in the next year. To get there we’re building a growth engine: channels, tools and agents that find the right engineers and get better every week. This role helps build and run it. It’s a broad role on the candidate side of Dex. One week you might launch a new acquisition channel. The next you might build a lead magnet, run a test on the website or ship a free tool like our engineer salary benchmark . What ties it together is systems: you’ll build the automations, agents and reporting that let a small team do the work of a much bigger one. You’ll learn growth from people who have done it before. Rob, our Head of Growth, led product growth at Cleo, and Luca, our Growth Lead, has built large B2B go-to-market teams. You’ll work directly with both of them, alongside Dex’s founding team, and see up close how a growth team gets built. Dex is AI-first: agents run our growth channels, our weekly reports are automated , and everyone here builds with Claude. You’ll work the same way from your first week. It’s for someone early in their career who is technical, commercially minded and wants to start a company one day. You don’t need growth experience. You need to think in systems, stay comfortable when nobody has defined the problem yet, and want more ownership than most companies would give you this early. What You’ll Do Own part of the growth engine: take on whole areas of how engineers find and join Dex, with targets for good candidates and the freedom to decide how to hit them. Build with AI: create the agents, automations and internal tools that take manual work off the team, and help work out how an AI-first growth team should run. Scale our acquisition channels: run and improve channels across paid, the jobs feed and creators. You’ll be hands-on in each one, finding what limits it and fixing it. Launch new channels: take a channel from first idea to a working system, test it against our own quality numbers and tell us plainly whether to scale it or stop. Build tools and lead magnets: ship free tools and resources that help engineers with their careers and bring them to Dex. Run website tests: design and run experiments on our site and landing pages, and make the winners the default. Own the numbers: build the reporting that shows what’s working across channels, and use it to decide where we put time and budget next. What We’re Looking For Technical and fluent in AI: you build with AI tools every day and can turn an idea into a working script, automation or agent. Ideally you have a computer science or other technical degree or master’s. Commercially driven: you care what something cost and what it returned, and you’d rather switch a channel off than defend one that isn’t working. A systems thinker: when you solve a problem you build the thing that solves it every time, so nobody has to do it by hand again. Comfort in ambiguity: you can take a goal with no brief, work out what the real problem is and make progress without waiting to be told how. A self-starter: you find the next thing to do without being asked, and you finish what you start. Startup experience: you’ve worked at an early-stage company, in a founders associate role or on something of your own, so you know how little gets handed to you. Ambition to found something: you want to start or run a company one day, and you want the ownership now that gets you there. Why Join Now The growth team is 4 people and the plan is to 10x, so there is more to build than there are people to build it. You’ll get real ownership and broad scope early, direct time with the people running growth, and a close view of how an AI-first company builds a team. We’re open on backgrounds. If you have the raw ingredients and have excelled where you are now, we want to hear from you, even if you don’t tick every box. What We Offer Above market salary - we’re building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you ‘have’ to take Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support Gym membership & wellness benefits Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip MacBook Pro + team kit “Whatever you need” approach to tools and support Interview Process We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect: We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren’t an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we’re building, and we love to hear your feedback. A 30m video call with Becca, our Head of Talent; we’ll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit. A call with Rob, our Head of Growth, on short and medium-term objectives and deeper questions on the role. A practical task to better understand how you work, completed offline and reviewed by the team. Onsite interview loop where you’ll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on your task, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p></p> <p>As Director, Intelligence & Insight, UK, you will help lead the growth of Burson’s Intelligence & Insights business across a portfolio of priority clients. Reporting to the Head of Intelligence & Insights, UK, you will act as senior counsel to clients and help the team continue to evolve in delivering outstanding value; identifying where intelligence can answer real business and reputation questions, shaping those opportunities into clear briefs, and turning data-led outputs into recommendations that senior stakeholders act on.</p> <p>You will also play a leading role in how our intelligence offer evolves. Working with the regional Intelligence & Insight hub, product and technology teams, you will identify where our methodologies need to develop to meet changing client needs, and make sure every new approach is clearly tied to the value it delivers. The role requires a strong understanding of the UK communications market, emerging technologies and the commercial potential of data, AI and intelligence in client work.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p></p> <ul> <li><strong>Growth:</strong> Own the growth agenda for intelligence across priority UK clients. Work with client leads to build, shape and convert pipeline, using Burson’s AI suite, wider tech stack and WPP Open platform to address live client challenges. Hold accountability for the revenue and commercial performance of your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Senior Counsel:</strong> Act as a trusted adviser to senior client stakeholders across communications, marketing and corporate affairs. Frame business and reputation challenges, guide decisions with evidence, and lead senior presentations and workshops that demonstrate the value of intelligence.</li> <li><strong>Opportunity Identification:</strong> Spot where intelligence can add value across existing accounts and new business. description: Prefer a couple of hard searches to forty easy ones? title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product (Hybrid)
description: <p><strong>Location: </strong>London, UK – Hybrid (2 days per week in office)</p> <p>With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. </p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You will also serve as OpenTable’s Deputy Privacy Officer, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with Booking Holdings, Inc. (BHI) on privacy and data protection matters. This role is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working closely with commercial, product and technical teams, navigating emerging areas of law, and developing practical solutions that enable responsible innovation at scale.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a primary legal partner to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing end-to-end counseling on new products, features, data uses, integrations, consumer experiences, and other strategic initiatives.</li> <li>Serve as Deputy Privacy Officer for OpenTable, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with BHI on privacy strategy, governance, regulatory developments, and group-wide privacy initiatives.</li> <li>Advise on global privacy and data protection requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles into OpenTable’s products and operations, including counseling on data collection, use, sharing, retention, consent, personalization, and consumer rights.</li> <li>Provide strategic legal guidance on the development, deployment, procurement, and use of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including generative AI and AI-powered product features, and help develop scalable AI governance frameworks as the regulatory landscape evolves.</li> <li>Provide strategic legal advice and guidance to Product teams regarding product development, launch, and sunsetting, with strong focus on legal risks related to data privacy, cybersecurity, data usage and ownership, consumer protection, and marketing. </li> <li>Partner closely with OpenTable’s Information Security team on cybersecurity and data security matters, including product and vendor security risk, security requirements, incident response, potential data breaches, regulatory obligations, and remediation.</li> <li>Identify and address emerging product, privacy, AI, security, consumer protection, and regulatory risks; draft and negotiate related agreements and terms; and develop scalable legal processes, policies, playbooks, and disclosures that enable the business to innovate responsibly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant experience advising on privacy, data protection, technology, and product matters, preferably in-house at a technology, consumer, marketplace, or other high-growth company.</li> <li>J.D. from an accredited U.S. law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar, or equivalent legal qualification and authorization to practice law in the United Kingdom.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of U.S. and global privacy and data protection laws, including GDPR and U.S. state privacy laws, as well as global consumer protection laws, with demonstrated experience translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical product and business guidance.</li> <li>Significant experience providing product counseling, including partnering directly with Product and Engineering teams on new products, features, data uses, and technology initiatives from development through launch.</li> <li>Experience supporting or helping lead a global privacy program, including privacy governance, policies, compliance frameworks, and cross-functional implementation.</li> <li>Experience advising on information security and cybersecurity matters, including security requirements, incident response, and related regulatory obligations.</li> <li>Strong judgment, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to assess risk, navigate ambiguity, and provide practical advice to cross-functional teams and senior leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience advising on artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including legal and regulatory considerations associated with developing, deploying, or procuring AI-enabled products and services.</li> <li>Experience working within a complex global organization or corporate group and partnering effectively with enterprise-level legal, privacy, security, compliance, or governance functions.</li> <li>CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, AIGP, or similar privacy or AI certification preferred.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5 weeks paid vacation</li> <li>Private health & dental insurance</li> <li>Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year</li> <li>Focus on mental health and well-being:</li> <ul> <li>Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth</li> <li>Company-paid subscription to Headspace</li> <li>Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)</li> </ul> <li>Paid parental leave</li> <li>Time off for your birthday</li> <li>Paid volunteer time</li> <li>Focus on your career growth:</li> <ul> <li>Development Dollars</li> <li>Leadership development</li> <li>Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings</li> </ul> <li>Travel Discounts</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups</li> <li>Income protection and life assurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice</li> <li>Pension plan contributions</li> <li>Discounted gym membership</li> <li>Bike2Work</li> <li>Season ticket loan</li> <li>Social events & Thursday happy hours</li> <li>Free lunch 2 days per week</li> </ul> <p>The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.</p> <p><strong>Work Environment & Flexibility</strong></p> <p>At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.</p> <p><strong>Inclusion</strong></p> <p>We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.</p> <p>If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. title: Principal Delivery Lead
description: Who is Atominvest Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows. Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset. At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big. It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet. We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred! Role Overview As Principal Delivery Lead, you will lead Atominvest's most complex enterprise deliveries for sophisticated alternative investment managers. You are the delivery lead from scoping through go-live and long-term adoption. You will also shape how Atominvest delivers: leading innovation in our delivery approach, setting the standard for an exceptional client experience, and making sure every programme leaves clients with lasting value. It is a hands-on senior role, grounded in deep PCM SaaS and private markets expertise. What You'll Be Doing Lead enterprise delivery • Own the delivery lifecycle as the senior face of Atominvest to CFOs, COOs and heads of operations and internal technology teams. • Run steering committees, executive reviews and detailed project updates. • Act as design authority, turning fund structures, portfolio data and reporting processes into platform design and a phased implementation plan • Scope integrations (APIs, SFTP, data feeds) with client technical teams, Product and Engineering, defining what's feasible and who builds what • Stay hands-on: analyse and reconcile complex datasets, configure the platform and solve technical problems yourself • Proactively manage risk, scope, change and customer health across complex programmes Shape how we deliver • Support and develop innovation in Atominvest's delivery approach: methodology, tooling, templates and documentation • Set and uphold the standards that define an exceptional client experience, and coach internal team members on best practice • Partner with Sales in pre-sales from a delivery angle: solution design, effort estimates and building out complex delivery SOWs Drive long-term value • Deliver solutions that embed Atominvest in clients' operating models and build the long-term value that drives renewal • Bridge clients and the product roadmap: feed structured insight to Product, influence prioritisation and own feature rollouts to your clients • Identify expansion opportunities through a deep understanding of clients' operating models and strategic goals Requirements • 8+ years leading enterprise B2B SaaS implementations end to end in financial services or asset management, with hands on experience configuring software and leading large-scale client programmes • Deep functional knowledge of the private markets and SaaS that serves this industry • A track record of developing and leading new delivery approaches, standards or methodologies that measurably improved client experience • Experience scoping complex SOWs and supporting pre-sales from a delivery perspective • Evidence of delivering solutions that drove long-term adoption, renewal and expansion • Exceptional consultative skills: you’ve run workshops, translated requirements, created delivery documentation, consulted with C-suite and back-office functions as the delivery SME. • Outstanding programme management: every dependency tracked, every deadline owned, changes communicated early, commercially minded around delivery budgets • Delivery substance first, with an entrepreneurial mindset: clients title: Senior Android Engineer
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. 👋 Hi, I'm Manuele Maggi, Engineering Manager at Motorway. I'm looking for a seasoned Senior Android Engineer to join our Mobile engineering group and help harness the latest tools, techniques, and technologies to build a best-in-class experience for our Sellers. It's an opportunity to join a talented team pushing the boundaries, working alongside bright minds in engineering, product, and design - with AI deeply embedded in how we build and how we work. Join us in this exciting mission to fundamentally change the way people sell their car. About the role As a Senior Android Engineer, you'll be responsible for leading the design and implementation of some of our most cutting-edge Android features. Day-to-day, you'll be: Collaborating with designers, product managers, and engineers. Architecting and implementing complex and interesting app features. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.</p> <p>In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.</p> <p>Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.</p> <p><strong>Day-to-day in this role you'll:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the revenue tracking infrastructure:</strong> own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place</li> <li><strong>Run the commercial operating cadence,</strong> including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership</li> <li><strong>Own sales planning across markets:</strong> set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals</li> <li><strong>Turn sales performance data into action</strong> by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on</li> <li><strong>Design and roll out incentive systems,</strong> including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue</li> <li><strong>Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion,</strong> so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side</li> <li><strong>Automate and scale with AI,</strong> removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a similar commercial role,</strong> ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.</li> <li><strong>A track record in sales planning:</strong> quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on with data and systems.</strong> You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing incentive models,</strong> variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>A builder and generalist</strong> who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders,</strong> able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.</li> <li><strong>Strong understanding of distinct sales motions,</strong> including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join us</strong></h2> <p>You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Make a visible impact every day,</strong> directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.</li> <li><strong>Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment,</strong> with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.</li> <li><strong>Build a career, not just a role,</strong> as DashOS grows across EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Deliver together</strong> in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Next steps</strong></h2> <p>If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! title: Field Marketing Manager- London
description: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. You’ll be one of the first marketers on our EMEA team, with real ownership over our field marketing strategy and how we bring the Modal brand and experiences to the region’s key tech hubs. You’ll design and run the events and in-person programs that put Modal in front of the ML engineers, AI teams, and founders at the most exciting AI companies across EMEA, and turn that attention into pipeline alongside our Sales team. This role is a great fit for someone who is connected to the region’s tech and AI communities, and is excited to own field marketing end to end, from strategy through to execution and results. sure great conversations turn into lasting relationships Track and report on program performance, including attendance, meetings booked, account engagement, and sourced and influenced pipeline, and title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description: London, Full time, £140,000–196,000+ Pivotal Research finds people who can work on the biggest risks facing humanity and gets them working on them. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and our programmes have more than doubled in size every year. We had 75 participants in 2026. In 2027 we plan to have at least 180 participants across five cohorts of our AI safety and biodefense fellowships, start at least two new programmes, and grow to at least 16 staff. We are hiring a COO to make sure Pivotal runs well now, still runs well at three times the size, and still runs well when we scale beyond that. You will be responsible for the team that supports execution of our programmes, finances, our systems & processes, and the London office. You will start by managing at least 2 people and build the team from there. You will be the second most senior person at Pivotal and work directly with Tobias Häberli, our CEO, who will focus on strategy, fundraising and new programmes. Why this role matters We think the next few years are unusually important. AGI could bring enormous benefits, and could also cause existential catastrophes. Reducing those risks depends on getting capable people working on the right problems early enough. Since 2024, 135 fellows have participated in our programmes. Alumni have gone on to roles at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI, and GovAI, as well as AI Safety fellowships and internships at Anthropic and OpenAI. We measure our success by the important work our fellows go on to do, and how much Pivotal helped them get there. Right now, our ambition is larger than our capacity to execute well at scale. That is the gap the COO will close, and will help us move from 75 participants in 2026 to at least 180 in 2027. Why work at Pivotal We are a small, mission-driven team at LISA in London. People build what they think should exist, and disagreement with leadership is welcome. Read more on Working at Pivotal (what we have done so far, what working here is like, and reasons this role might not suit you). What you will own You are responsible for the whole of Pivotal outside programme design, research, and fundraising. In practice, that means: Execution. Every programme we run should be excellent. You make sure the infrastructure, systems, and team members supporting each programme work, and you fix what does not. The team. You build and lead the execution team that supports all of our programmes. You decide who we need, make the case for key hires, and run the hiring for your part of the organisation. Early on, Tobias will give input on hires and sign off on final decisions. Scaling. Pivotal needs to grow several times over without becoming worse at what it does. You design how a 16-person organisation runs, and then one that doubles or triples again in the years after. How decisions get made, how money is managed, how new programmes get launched, and how we have operational greatness while we grow. Finance, legal, compliance, systems, and the London office are primarily your responsibility. You will be well-resourced with a team to help you do all of it. Day-to-day leadership in London. Tobias works partly from Switzerland. You are the senior person on the ground, and you make most day-to-day decisions. This frees Tobias to focus on strategy, fundraising, networking, hiring, finding collaborators, and designing new programmes. Who we are looking for The range runs from someone who has already scaled an organisation through rapid growth beyond Pivotal’s current size, to someone who has not done that yet but has a proven track record and shows excellent aptitude for scaling an organisation. Wherever you sit in that range, we want to see some of the following: A record of making things happen. You have taken responsibility for something hard and delivered. People who have worked with you describe you as the person who is on top of things. A record of building and leading a team. You have hired and managed people, set clear expectations, and give direct feedback. You keep teams motivated and supported through rapid growth and intense periods. You build systems. You have improved how a team or organisation works. You can spot where a process will break as demands grow and design systems the team wants to use. You are decisive and high agency. You can prioritise between competing demands, are comfortable deciding with incomplete information, and take ownership of the outcomes. You spot what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked. When something is broken or missing, you take ownership until it’s fixed. You integrate AI well. AI is becoming increasingly important for how Pivotal works. You should have good judgement about where it helps, and where it does not. You make difficult decisions during difficult times. We expect the stakes of our work to only increase, and AI safety work to get a lot more public attention. Strong commitment to the mission. You do not need a background in AI safety, but you should see it as work worth committing a substantial part of your career to. You are honest and direct. Pivotal is small and moves fast. We need someone who tells us when we are wrong. Experience in a fast-growing organisation, a start-up, a scale-up or a similar organisation is a strong plus. What we offer Salary: £140,000–196,000. We can pay more for exceptional candidates. Benefits: Relocation support, a contribution to private health insurance, a personal development budget, childcare support, and an employer pension contribution of at least 5%. Location: London. Hours and start date: Full time. Start as soon as possible, but we’re willing to wait for the right candidate. Visa: We can sponsor a skilled worker visa for this role. Hiring Process We try to respect your time at every step. Written application. A short form about who you are and why this role. Screening interview. 25–30 minutes, personal. Work task (paid). A task that reflects the real job. Personal chat. A conversation with Tobias. Work trial (paid). Two to three days working with us in London (costs covered). title: Product Manager
description: Our Mission We're not your average benefits platform; we're the unordinary force that uplifts people's lives. Your Mission As our Product Manager , you will own the outcomes of something new at Ben: agents that do benefits admin work for HR and reward teams. Today an admin running a payroll cycle or sending files to benefit providers spends days in spreadsheets and email threads, and one wrong line shows up in someone's pay. Your job is to give them that time back, and you'll be measured on whether it happens: hours saved, errors avoided, customers live, and how much work the agent completes without anyone stepping in. Ben already runs benefits for hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries, which gives a new product real data and real configuration to work with from the start. Gone all in on AI: AI is how you work by default. Something big to own: You'll own a whole area of the product, with the scope that usually comes at a more senior level elsewhere, and you'll decide what goes in the first version. Scale from day one: Ben already runs benefits for hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries, at companies like Mondelez and Octopus Energy. Close to the decisions: You'll work directly with the Head of Product and the leadership team on where the product goes next. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role We're hiring a Customer Success Engineer to join the Technical Solutions team, the small team that keeps Omnea working for our customers every day. This role is based in London. This is a customer-facing role with a technical problem-solving heart: when an integration breaks, a workflow misbehaves, or a customer needs Omnea to do something it doesn't do yet, you help find the root cause and the right solution. We resolve around 95% of what comes to us ourselves, from straightforward fixes to changes in production code and small feature requests. You'll be trusted to work out what's really wrong and see it through, drawing on the team's support when you need it. You'll go deep on the product and broad on the problems: an integration misbehaving with a customer's ERP in the morning, a feature a customer has been asking for after lunch, and helping a colleague through a tough customer conversation by the end of the day. You'll be a trusted voice customers can turn to, joining their calls, providing clear answers and working closely with the Account Management team to set them up for long-term success with Omnea. AI helps us investigate faster, tracing logs, drafting hypotheses and suggesting fixes, but people own the outcome. You'll use your judgment, and the team's expertise where needed, to make sure solutions are safe for a live enterprise environment, address the root cause and surface patterns Product needs to hear about. The CSE team sits between Customer, Product and Engineering. It's a small, close-knit team with a lot of autonomy, and the scope of the role grows as Omnea does. There is room to lean into your strengths, whether that's guiding customers towards solutions or bringing their feedback into the product, while building your technical skills. You'll develop deep knowledge of Omnea, and your work will be felt by customers every day. What You'll Do Investigate the hard problems. One issue might be an integration failing with a customer's ERP, the next a workflow that isn't doing what anyone expected, the next a cross-system bug nobody else has cracked. You'll use AI to speed up the first pass, then confirm the cause and get it fixed. Make solutions happen. Own issues through to resolution, whether that means guiding a customer through a solution, improving a workflow or working on a code change. You'll have opportunities to fix bugs and build small customer-requested features in the codebase, with support from the team as you grow. Depending on your strengths, you might lean further into customer guidance or into shaping and improving the product. Back up our Implementation and Customer teams. When a colleague hits a tricky configuration, an edge case or a question they can't answer, they come to you. You'll help them think it through, step into live implementations when they get technical, and make sure the customer gets the right answer. Stay close to customers. You'll have ongoing calls with some customers, join QBRs and escalation calls, get brought in on specialist projects, and represent the Technical Solutions Team when customers move from implementation to ongoing support. Bring the customer's voice into Product. You'll hear what customers struggle with before anyone else does. Spot the patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-argued input for Product, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice. Make it scale. As we grow, we can't just add people. You'll build the tooling, automation, playbooks and docs that help customers solve more on their own and let the team handle more without slowing down. About You You have at least 3 years of relevant experience, for example in technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, software development or another technical, customer-facing role. You're curious. You want to know how things work and why they broke, and every problem is a chance to learn something. You solve problems analytically. You enjoy messy, ambiguous issues, and you don't stop at the symptom when you can find the root cause. You're comfortable switching context. A bug fix, a customer call and a colleague's question can all land in the same hour, and you can move between them without losing the thread. You want variety. You'd rather handle ten different problems than one big project. You take ownership. You work independently, raise your hand for the hard problems, and see them through to resolution without needing the spotlight. You care about customers, about getting it right, and about the team around you. You're inspired by the idea of unreasonable hospitality: going beyond the expected to make people feel genuinely looked after. You explain technical issues clearly, whether you're talking to an engineer or a non-technical stakeholder. You're not afraid of the technical side. You don't need a CS or STEM degree: technical aptitude can come from your work, side projects or things you've built yourself. Hands-on experience with APIs, SQL or integrations helps, and you'll pick up the codebase with AI, the docs and the team behind you. You use AI tools to move faster, with the judgment to know what to trust and what to double-check. At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company.
