We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. The General Capabilities team is developing the science that makes that possible: a principled, evidence-based method for building agentic systems automatically. We are hiring for several positions on this team through one application. Depending on your background, you will work on our agent runtime, on evaluation, or on automated agentic system optimisation. We are looking for experienced systems engineers and researchers. Since we are an interdisciplinary team, we expect depth in one area and a willingness to work across the others. We oversee all operations within the grocery and retail ecosystem, ensuring stores are equipped to receive and efficiently process orders. Our solutions empower stores to manage orders seamlessly through multiple channels, including our in-house app, API integration, and devices pre-installed with our software. Additionally, we provide tools to maintain and update product catalogs, ensuring accurate inventory for consumers. This role is based in our London office with a <strong>hybrid</strong> setup, typically 3 days in the office.</p> <p>Get to know our <a class="ng-star-inserted" href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/software-engineering-at-deliveroo/" target="_blank">Engineering</a> team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.</p> <h3>What You’ll Be Doing</h3> <p>You’ll be joining a multi-disciplinary engineering team focused on technical execution and collaboration. health.</p> <p>Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Drive Technical Excellence:</strong> Improve code structure and architecture across your team’s remit, developing, title: Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>Our global Legal team has built a strong reputation within the company for our highly collaborative and supportive approach to counseling, always with a bias for action. We are a diverse group of lawyers and legal professionals with a shared passion for providing creative, best-in-class service to our business partners. The Competition & Litigation team advises DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo on antitrust, competition, and litigation matters across every market we operate in.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Counsel, Competition & Litigation to join our growing Legal team and work globally across the DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo brands. Reporting to the Director, Competition & Litigation, you’ll be a generalist antitrust attorney who can move fast: advising product and business teams in real time, supporting M&A and strategic investments alongside our Corporate Development team, and driving forward regulatory investigations and inquiries, with a particular focus on Europe. This is a hybrid role that will require you to work from our London HQ or Brussels office for a minimum of 3 days a week. </p> <h2>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted antitrust/competition advisor to product, business, and corporate development teams, delivering fast, practical counsel that lets the business move with velocity while properly managing risk.</li> <li>Advise on the competition and antitrust dimensions of M&A transactions, strategic investments, and commercial partnerships, partnering closely with Corporate Development and our sales teams.</li> <li>Manage antitrust and competition regulatory investigations and inquiries globally.</li> <li>Help build out DoorDash’s international competition compliance program, partnering with the Director, Competition & Litigation on training, policies, and processes across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.</li> <li>Support competition-related litigation matters as needed, including document collection and review, witness preparation, and responses to third-party subpoenas.</li> <li>Partner with policy and government relations teams to track legal and regulatory developments that could affect the business.</li> </ul> <h2>We’re excited about you because…</h2> <ul> <li>You are a qualified solicitor in England & Wales (or bring similar qualifications in another European jurisdiction) with significant experience providing strategic legal advice to international businesses.</li> <li>You have 7+ years of experience at a leading law firm and/or in-house legal department, with a strong grounding in antitrust/competition law as a generalist — spanning M&A counseling, litigation, and regulatory/government investigations.</li> <li>You have experience advising on competition issues in mergers, acquisitions, and strategic investments, including regulatory filings and clearance strategy.</li> <li>You have experience handling antitrust/competition regulatory inquiries or investigations, ideally including direct engagement with regulators such as the European Commission, UK CMA, DOJ, FTC, or other competition authorities.</li> <li>You’re comfortable operating as a generalist across a broad portfolio — you don’t need deep pre-existing expertise in every sub-area, but you can quickly get up to speed and give practical, business-minded advice.</li> <li>You’re an excellent product counselor: able to translate complex antitrust concepts into clear, fast, actionable guidance for product and business teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and legal systems, and can navigate the added complexity of advising across three global brands (DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo).</li> <li>You have strong organizational skills and can juggle multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving environment, both independently and as part of a team.</li> <li>You’re an outstanding communicator, both orally and in writing, with sound judgment on when to escalate and when to move forward independently.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h3> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems title: Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">We are hiring a <strong>Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager</strong> to lead the team that keeps Canonical's security and compliance credible to the Enterprises, Clouds, Telcos and Governments that run on Ubuntu, and to bring our controls and risk management to the standard a public company requires.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA or Americas — fully remote (home-based), with the option to work from our London office.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>About our Team</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">Canonical's customers trust Ubuntu with critical systems. That trust rests on evidence: our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications, how we manage risk, and how we respond as security regulation such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act reaches open source software. The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team produces that evidence and makes it real across the company. As Canonical prepares to list on a public exchange, the team is also central to the controls and risk reporting our Audit Committee and Board rely on.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">The team is part of Operations and reports to the Chief Operating Officer. It covers both sides of the discipline: keeping us certified and compliant today, and looking ahead at risk across corporate IT, infrastructure and products. It works closely with Engineering, Security Operations, Information Systems, Legal, Finance and Sales.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: Arial, serif; font-size: 10pt;">You will lead the team, set its priorities and operating rhythm, and be the first escalation point for security and compliance decisions.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Lead and develop a team of GRC engineers: hire, coach and set priorities, and run a roadmap that balances planned work with operational requests, so the team delivers predictably and reports progress clearly to leadership. You own the team’s budget, vendors and tooling.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Own our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certifications end to end: audit readiness, evidence collection, auditor relationships and fieldwork, so certifications are renewed on time with clean outcomes.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Run the risk management framework across corporate IT, infrastructure and products — asset classification, risk assessments, the risk register and key risk indicators — so leadership and the Board can see and decide on the company’s most important risks.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Own the information security policy framework — annual reviews, new policies, exceptions and risk acceptance — and make the call, or escalate it, when a policy and a business need conflict.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Partner with Finance on IT General Controls and internal controls over financial reporting — remediation, control execution and Audit Committee reporting — to make Canonical ready for a public listing.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Turn security regulation and standards — the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, DORA, the EU AI Act and IEC 62443 — into practical programmes with Legal and Engineering, including our secure software development lifecycle and penetration testing, so our products meet their obligations as they ship.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Build business continuity and disaster recovery with Information Systems and business owners — impact analysis, plans and tested recovery — so critical services can be restored when it matters.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Oversee third-party risk, access reviews and the governance of new tools and AI usage, and support customers and colleagues when it counts — security questionnaires, RFPs, our Trust Center, contract security terms and incident response — alongside Sales, Legal and Security Operations.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Hands-on ownership of ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 certification through external audit cycles</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience designing or running a risk management framework (such as ISO 27005, NIST CSF or ISO 31000), including a risk register and reporting to senior leadership</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience with IT General Controls supporting financial audits, under SOX or an equivalent regime</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience leading a governance, risk and compliance, security compliance or IT risk team in a software or technology company</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience turning regulatory and technical requirements into controls that engineering and business teams you don’t manage actually adopt</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Sound judgement on risk acceptance and policy exceptions, and the confidence to hold a position with senior stakeholders</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience preparing a company for a public listing</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Experience with product security compliance for a software vendor (EU Cyber Resilience Act, IEC 62443 or NIST SSDF)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Business continuity and disaster recovery programme experience</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>How we work</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Distributed work environment, with bi-annual team travel to connect in person</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Priority Pass for travel</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Bi-annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>About Canonical</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Canonical is an <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/company-culture/identity">equal opportunity employer</a>. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination, and regardless of your identity we will give your application fair consideration.</span></p>

title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong> to lead Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function and to build the legal architecture a public company needs — commercial contracting, corporate governance, intellectual property and compliance — in a software business that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and advise the CEO, CFO and the Board directly.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: <strong>Location</strong>: This role can be home-based in EMEA, or office-based in our London, UK office.</p> <h3><strong>About our team</strong></h3> <p>Canonical’s Legal and Compliance function is a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. It owns the terms on which Ubuntu and our commercial products reach the market: open source and intellectual property licensing, enterprise and channel contracting, data protection, export controls and trade, competition, and the governance a company preparing to list has to be able to evidence.</p> <p>Canonical is founder-led, profitable and growing, and privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. That makes this a function in transition. The work is as much building the architecture — a management layer across two regions, standard contracting positions, controls, policies and records — as it is advising on live matters, and it is done in a company that regularly does things the industry has not done before, so the precedents often do not exist.</p> <p>The team works with Product and Engineering on licensing and IP, with Security on customer assurance, with Finance on listing readiness and controls, and with Sales on the commitments we make to customers. As General Counsel you lead that team, set its standards, and advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board and its committees directly.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the global Legal and Compliance function: set its structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas, so the business gets consistent answers wherever it operates.</li> <li>Build the management layer: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Set the operating cadence of the function: how legal work is taken in and prioritised, what internal clients can expect and when, and how workload and risk are reported to the leadership team.</li> <li>Own public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advise the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and support Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Own the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Lead intellectual property and open source licensing strategy: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Own the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition, and AI regulation.</li> <li>Manage litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, and own the external counsel panel, its budget and the quality of its work.</li> <li>Advise on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Qualified as a lawyer, with a law degree or equivalent and an active licence to practise in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>In-house legal leadership in a software or technology company — a business that licenses its own products, rather than one that buys technology to run its operations.</li> <li>Commercial technology contracting: enterprise software and subscription agreements, channel and reseller agreements, cloud and services, and hardware manufacturer agreements.</li> <li>Open source licensing: permissive and copyleft licences, trademark, and how open source communities work in practice.</li> <li>Corporate governance for a listed company, or for one preparing to list: board and committee support, delegated authority, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>Building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under-performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English, with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally two to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practising as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>We look for a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results, backed by self-motivation and drive. Our people deliver their work precisely, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliability is at our core, where colleagues deliver high quality work that builds trust and confidence. We make ourselves accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Finally we are adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Staff Brand Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 <strong>London </strong>| 💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</strong> |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <h4><strong>⭐ Our Design team</strong></h4> <p>We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</p> <p>Our brand helps make Monzo recognisable and human, whether someone is opening the app, visiting our website or seeing a campaign for the first time. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Brand Designer</strong> to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.</p> <p>You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.</p> <p>This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Shaping our creative direction.</strong> Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.</li> <li><strong>Leading ambitious work. </strong>You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.</li> <li><strong>Creating standout design.</strong> You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.</li> <li><strong>Managing and developing designers.</strong> Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar across the team.</strong> Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Connecting brand and product.</strong> Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.</li> <li><strong>Evolving our brand systems.</strong> Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.</li> <li><strong>Influencing decisions across teams.</strong> Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Working with creative partners.</strong> Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Improving how we work.</strong> Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.</li> <li>You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in <strong>typography, visual identity and art direction</strong>. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.</li> <li>You have <strong>experience managing and developing designers</strong>, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.</li> <li>You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.</li> <li>You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.</li> <li>You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

title: Sales Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London | 💰 £60k – £80k base salary | £100k – £135k OTE + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits">Benefits</a></p> <h3><strong>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></h3> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than a million businesses (1 in 6!) in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe 🚀</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.</p> <p>You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leading a team of Account Executives.</strong> Manage a pod of 6–8 people and be accountable for its performance, from reaching the right businesses and converting opportunities to customer activation and quality. Translate the wider Business strategy and set clear expectations, understand what’s driving results and act when performance needs to improve.</li> <li><strong>Coaching and developing your team.</strong> Spend time listening to calls, reviewing opportunities and giving clear, regular feedback. Help each person build their skills and confidence, recognise great work and address underperformance fairly. Help hire and onboard new team members as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Building the sales motion.</strong> Turn what you and your team learn into better ways of working. Spot friction in lead handling, follow-up, handovers and the sales process; test improvements, measure their impact and share what works so we can build a repeatable playbook.</li> <li><strong>Staying close to customers.</strong> We expect Sales Managers to also take a few sales calls each week and make a few sales a month. Use what you learn from customers and the sales journey to coach the team, identify product needs and improve the motion. Most of your time will be spent leading the team and improving how we work.</li> <li><strong>Helping shape our Products.</strong> Share what you learn from customers with Product to help shape our proposition and priorities, and use what we learn to improve how we sell.</li> <li><strong>Putting AI and automation to work.</strong> Experiment with tools, agents and workflows that help the team research prospects, prepare for conversations, follow up or learn from calls. Work with specialist teams to test ideas responsibly, understand their impact and help the team adopt what works.</li> <li><strong>Making good decisions with data.</strong> Use pipeline, conversion, activation, productivity and quality data to understand where the team is doing well and where customers or opportunities are getting stuck. Keep the pipeline accurate and work with RevOps on reporting and forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Working as one team.</strong> Bring frontline insight to RevOps, Product, Marketing and Operations. Help shape the tools, processes and customer journeys Sales needs, and work together to solve problems that affect your team and customers.</li> <li><strong>Earning customers’ trust.</strong> Build a culture that puts customers first. Coach your team to understand their needs, represent Monzo accurately and deliver good outcomes. Raise concerns early and work with Risk, Compliance and Legal when needed.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You’ve managed and developed a sales team. You can share examples of how you’ve coached individuals, given feedback and improved performance, including when conversations were difficult.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses in a relatively high-volume environment. You can balance an efficient process with thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.</li> <li>You’re a builder. You’ve spotted a problem in how a team sells, tried a better approach and helped people put it into practice. title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

You'll do this across two big strategic bets: going deep in the UK market and expanding our products into Europe, all while we scale to millions more customers.</p> <p>You will be able to leverage our established and award-winning customer service operations whilst also working closely with the Product, Engineering, Partnerships and Risk & Compliance teams to deliver a delightful experience for our users. title: Forward Deployed Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes. This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams. The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption. - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale. - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation. - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value. - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback. - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path. - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements. - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role. - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria. - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions. - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows. - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively. - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value. - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness. - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences. - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward. - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers. - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows. - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up. - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements. - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the CFO, you will <strong>design and own the tax processes</strong> that support our global expansion. Your primary challenge will be navigating the complexity of the evolving global environment in which we operate, where tax rules are constantly evolving. You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business - tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and strategic thinking</strong> over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Managing and coordinating the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings</li> <li>Working with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation</li> <li>Acting as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.</li> <li>Identifying opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation</li> <li>Managing and running tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements</li> <li>Working closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment</li> <li>Monitoring changes in tax legislation across the regions in which we operate and assess their potential impact on the company.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</span></li> <li>Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, technology or other quantitative field.</li> <li>Full accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) and tax advisor (CTA, ADIT or equivalent) qualifications.</li> <li>A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant tax experience, gained within a Big 4/Top 10 accounting firm or a multinational in-house tax team.</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results.</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders.</li> <li><span style="font-weight: 300;">Business level written and spoken English</span> with excellent presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>Focus on results, with a personal drive to meet commitments.</li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation.</li> <li><span style="font-weight: 300;">Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Bi-annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Company recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><span style="font-weight: 300;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 300;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Finance Forecasting Modeller
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting Team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting team (CIF) sits at the intersection of our Borrowing and Finance collectives, responsible for developing, executing and managing the models used to calculate IFRS 9 ECL, and credit risk capital through the annual ICAAP. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>
